name: pod_metrics
description: App plugin: live CPU, memory, status and restarts of the pods in an OpenShift namespace, compared with their limits. Read-only.
author: Aravinthan Selvaraj

arguments.name: environment
arguments.description: OpenShift environment whose oc.generic login session is used (log in with oc.generic first).

arguments.name: namespace
arguments.description: OpenShift project to watch; the session's current project when empty. It can be changed on the live page.

arguments.name: max_rows
arguments.description: Most pods shown in the table.

outputs.name: namespace
outputs.description: Namespace read on the last refresh.

outputs.name: attention_count
outputs.description: Pods not finished and not fully running and ready.

outputs.name: cpu_millicores
outputs.description: CPU used by the namespace's pods, in millicores.

outputs.name: memory_mib
outputs.description: Memory used by the namespace's pods, in MiB.

outputs.name: metrics_available
outputs.description: False when the metrics API could not be read, so usage is missing.

outputs.name: pods
outputs.description: One entry per pod: status, ready, restarts, node, age, and CPU and memory with limits.

app.title: Pod metrics
app.description: Pods of an OpenShift namespace, refreshed live. Usage comes from the metrics API, so it is a recent sample rather than this instant.

inputs.name: namespace
inputs.label: Namespace
inputs.placeholder: Blank: the argument, else the session's project
